ov: Over a dozen species of small, lean, mostly nocturnal mammals of tropical Asia and Africa, most in the family Viverridae. The popular name "civet cat" is inaccurate: they are not cats. Civets produce a strong musk, also called civet, long used in perfume.
rg: Tropical Asia and Africa, especially tropical forests; most species live in Southeast Asia.
df: Omnivores: the African civet eats rodents and other small animals, invertebrates, eggs, carrion and plants.
fx: Kopi luwak, one of the world’s most expensive coffees, is made from coffee cherries eaten and passed by the Asian palm civet.
The African civet sleeps in dense vegetation by day and wakes up at sunset.
